messages:
Alex M.: Quick one — final-round candidate (ML infra) today 4:00pm PT. Interviewer assigned (Jordan) just got pulled into an outage, might be unavailable. Need: interviewer coverage OR a scribe for notes + confirmation on recording consent. Can someone step in?
Nisha R.: I can cover as interviewer if we switch the order with my 5pm candidate (they're flexible). Is the debrief slot still 5:30 PT?
Alex M.: Yes debrief is 5:30 PT. Thanks Nisha — can you take the 4pm slot then? If so we still need a scribe for notes (we prefer someone not in the panel).
Pat G.: I can scribe. Do we have the current rubric link & scribe template?
Rebecca (People Ops): scribing — thanks Pat. Rubric is the live doc: https://redwood-docs.internal/hiring/rubric-v3 (use the "final round" tab). Scribe template: https://drive.redwood/handbook/scribe-template.md. Reminder: candidate must opt in to recording — check consent on the calendar invite or ask at start.
Alex M.: Spot on. @Interview Bot can you annotate the event with "recording consent needed" and add Pat as co-host?
Interview Bot: Event updated — added note "confirm recording consent at start" and made Pat a co-host on the 4:00pm invite. Calendar invite refreshed.
Nisha R.: Swapped orders with my 5pm slot, confirmed. I'll run the technical deep dive + low-level design. Quick ask: are we using the latency benchmark prompt from eval-set-2026 for regression checks?
Rebecca (People Ops): For final round we use eval-set-2026 for regression anchors; not required to run during interview but include in debrief if any red flags. For debrief, please fill score + short bullet evidence in the rubric doc, then ping me if calibration is needed.
Pat G.: Got it — I'll publish notes to the scribe template and attach to the candidate thread after debrief. One more: do we still require transcript capture? Candidate preferred text transcript if recorded — I'll enable auto-transcript.
Alex M.: Thanks everyone. Last check: @Nisha R. want me to DM the candidate about the small order change or you prefer to handle?
Nisha R.: I'll message them — quick apology + confirm new time.
Rebecca (People Ops): I'll run the debrief at 5:30 PT. If anyone can't make it, record a short 5-min async note in the rubric doc and tag me. :thumbsup:
Alex M.: Perfect. Closing this thread — huge help on short notice :heart:
